paragraphs: SETTING: Four strangers are trapped in a room.
AT RISE: Actor position from right to left: Megan, Ethan, Christopher, Rachel. The button in the middle. Ethan lying on Christopher’s lap.
(everyone explore the room, realizing there is no where out)

AI VOICE:Welcome to HUMAN VERIFICATION TEST NUMBER #67. Please remain calm. There is no escape. You have one mission. There is one robot in this room, find out who, when you have decided, press the button. Or else, everyone will be executed. You have 15 minutes.
MEGAN:Huh. What?! Is this some kind of prank?! Who set this up? (standing up)
RACHEL:This must be a joke, how insane?!

CHRISTOPHER:(checks his wristwatch, condescendingly)A joke? Huh. (disdained) If this were a kidnapping, my lawyers would have already infiltrated the building. Whoever designed this budget escape room clearly lacks taste.
MEGAN:(knocking and kicking the door angrily)Hey! Let us out! you freaking robot!!!
ETHAN:Wow, everyone, calm down. Maybe we can introduce ourselves first.
RACHEL:Huh, easy for you to say, like who are you.
CHRISTOPHER:(bombastic side eye, puts on sleek glasses)Christopher.
ETHAN:Great.(clap) Now let's recap. The four of us (points at everyone) are now trapped in a room by some mysterious robot.
MEGAN:And among the four of us (hands crossed) is an imposter. (side eye)
MEGAN:Did you just call me an idiot?
ETHAN:Alright alright, please stop arguing for those... We should focus on finding the imposter.
CHRISTOPHER:Maybe we should look around first.
RACHEL:Can we just press the button?
EVERYONE ELSE:(turn to the button) No!
ETHAN:We don't know just who the bot is.
CHRISTOPHER:How do we know you aren't the robot trying to keep us docile so the timer runs out?
RACHEL:Wait(hands reach pocket) Cut it, everyone, check your pocket.(checks pockets)Oh… I don’t have a pocket.
(Megan notices something, pulls it out and shows it to the audience)
MEGAN:Nothing, too.(says it with fear of difference)
CHRISTOPHER:I guess the AI is smart enough to take our phones.
RACHEL:Let me think. What are some human things? Reflexes... (murmurs) Heads up!(claps beside Megan's ear.)
CHRISTOPHER:You told us that you had nothing in your pocket, didn't you?
RACHEL:Hey, Megan still hasn't answered our question. Don't try to cover her up.
MEGAN:(take away the card from Ethan’s hand)
RACHEL:You really have to say “interesting” in every act, do you?
ETHAN:“Don’t you.” Anyway, guys, should we go in?
MEGAN:Of course. (throw the card,walk straight forward) I'm tired of this place.
SETTING: Memory room, where it shows one’s past.
AT RISE: Actor position from right to left: Rachel, Ethan, Christopher, Megan. A stand with a photo frame on the left downstage.
RACHEL:Isn’t that great? ‘Cause you can blend in here perfectly, camouflage, you know.
MEGAN:I can’t see anything. Where's the light?
ETHAN:Hey, isn’t this the same room?
AI VOICE:Welcome to the Memory Room.
MEGAN:Memory room? I get the room part, but where's the memory?
I guess this AI is deaf.
ETHAN:Look over there. There is something on the table.(picks up a picture frame)Is this...
RACHEL:Oh, so you aren't blind! Sorry about that earlier.
MEGAN:You are literally in the picture.
(take frame, hold it up to Christopher)
CHRISTOPHER:That doesn't necessarily make it mine.
RACHEL:I'll take that as a yes.
There's also some writing on the back.
RACHEL:And would you still say that this doesn't belong to you? Chris-topher?
RACHEL:Oh, ‘cause he needs to remember, forgive and forget.
CHRISTOPHER:Stop. (facepalm) This doesn't help. You know there are other things in this room.(walk backwards gesturing)
RACHEL:I guess I'm trapped in a room with two blinds now. (tilts head)
ETHAN:Chris does make a point. Our goal here is to find out who the robot is.
CHRISTOPHER:I don't remember letting you call me by that name.
RACHEL:And how would you possibly do that?
RACHEL:We're all gonna die at this point.
CHRISTOPHER:So have you checked the lost and found, Mr. Optimistic?
RACHEL:Seeeee. (gesture at the three to the audience) Like, ugh. Well, I guess since we're all gonna die, why not fulfill our little curiosity?
ETHAN:And the card did say access to one’s memory, too.
(sigh) I can't believe I'm telling this to three strangers while my life is being threatened.
MEGAN:It is actually a good chance though. As your ex-lover will be in your last words.
RACHEL:I thought you thought everything was interesting, judging by how many times you say “interesting.”
CHRISTOPHER:Do you want to hear about it or not?
AT RISE: Christopher moves to the middle. Others slightly back off.
CHRISTOPHER:It was when I was still working as a manager.
AT RISE: Liam standing in the middle of the stage facing the desk with files on top on his left. Christopher stands by the right curtain, Ben and CEO by the left.
Don't tell me you knew this.(holding up a file)
CHRISTOPHER:So what?! You know well what the consequences are!
LIAM:(chuckle) They were the one stealing! They were the ones snatching other’s proposal and claiming it’s theirs! What I'm doing is purely what they are doing. An eye for an eye.
CHRISTOPHER:What if the CEO finds out? (grabs Liam’s arms) What if anyone finds out? Our group would become thieves. (point right)

LIAM:He wouldn’t know! (shakes off Christopher) Nobody’s gonna know! And even if so, they had already overlooked Ben’s team so many times, just because he’s the chairman’s son. (points left)And you, you're the CEO’s son! Of course he is going to forgive you, like what could he possibly do.
CHRISTOPHER:No! It doesn't work like that! You don’t even know I’m not…
LIAM:Hey! Come on Chris! What do I mean to you?
CEO:It seems to me that this conversation could clarify my confusion.
LIAM:(turns over in surprise)ah.(turns back, look down)

CEO:You know what I want to hear, don’t you? Explanation? (holds up paper)(put on desk)(Ben hands more files)(go through files) Ben showed me clear evidence that they came up with the proposal of building a psychological test. Detailed meeting minutes, thought processes, clearly something other groups can't put their hands on. So how come it was submitted by your group? (put files on desk) There is only one explanation.
CHRISTOPHER:(leap forward) They did it first. (look at CEO straight in the eye)
CEO:Motive doesn’t matter, the results are what I see.
CHRISTOPHER:The results are what you only see.
CEO:(freeze) Well, yes.(laugh, puts hands in pocket) Of course, and do you know what I see now?
Ben:13 people sleeping by the side of the street!
Ben:Yes! 13! 14 minus 1, you know well who will be staying and who will not.
Ben:Hmmmmm, but maybe, let’s say if it is one’s decision, or one taking it upon himself… just maybe… it would be the reverse! hehehe
CHRISTOPHER:Because I need to tell the truth!
You just didn't want to pay the price.
(Liam walk straight forward to stage left, Ben and CEO follow)
AT RISE: Christopher stands in the middle. Others standing by the side.
CHRISTOPHER:What was I supposed to do?
Take the blame for something I didn't do?
Lose everything my father had given me?
So Liam could feel like I was a good friend?
He told me to tell the truth.
AT RISE: Christopher standing in the middle, Rachel on his left hand side, Ethan and Megan on the right.
CHRISTOPHER:Like what could I have done, let the whole group go down with him just because?!
ETHAN:There must be some other ways…
RACHEL:You wish, like what would you’ve done?
MEGAN:Ya, like, I don't think you realized that not every problem can be solved without sacrifices.
CHRISTOPHER:We are not living in a Utopia.
ETHAN:Nor a dystopia. I am well aware that sometimes sacrifices are necessary, but we need to aim for the solution with minimal damage.
RACHEL:So what is the ideal solution to this situation? You know we still are trapped in this room.
RACHEL:(cut off Megan) Well technically not this room, ‘cause there’s also the other room, so its two rooms, you get it.
RACHEL:What now? I thought you wanted to talk and so I let you talk.
CHRISTOPHER:Don’t tell me that you forget what you wanted to say?
RACHEL:You should check the lost and found, you’ll also see Ethan there.
RACHEL:Oh, but like, it’s not all my fault, right? At least now we know that she’s definitely a human.
I should shut up and let her talk shouldn’t I.
ETHAN:Why does this seem so familiar? Anyways. Megan, please continue.
The thought that occurred to me and left me and came back is…
MEGAN:Why are we even talking about Christopher's past?
CHRISTOPHER:I would like to know why too.
CHRISTOPHER:Hint for who is the robot? I do not believe my disgraceful past would help with that.
RACHEL:It would’ve been nice if you continue with it, parallelism you know. but clearly you don’t know that sooo…
MEGAN:Blah blah blah, can you just shut up?
RACHEL:Actually I don’t need to talk. ‘Cause Mr. “I would sacrifice my mate for the sake of others” would give a better interpretation of what I wanted to say. (gesture to Christopher)
(adjust tie)“Great achievement is usually born of great sacrifice, and is never the result of selfishness.”
MEGAN:Turning literature all of the sudden, I thought our setting is comedy, judging by how we all look like dumbass clowning around.
ETHAN:(whisper to Megan) Don’t you think this line would fit Rachel better?
(Megan make bruh face, back to the sofa)
ETHAN:(clear throat) I get it now, so you are saying that Chris would sacrifice someone when he’s under pressure?
RACHEL:So maybe that’s why he is here.
MEGAN:(stand up from the sofa)Ugh! How much longer are we gonna stand here and talk? We should just flip a coin and let God decide at this point.
CHRISTOPHER:Why are you so interested in making sure nobody decides?
ETHAN:Huh? Because we just don’t know!
RACHEL:Like he should change his personality just because. Talk about consistency, you are the one that always says everything is so (quote and quote)“INTERESTING”.
CHRISTOPHER:I am not talking about personality.
CHRISTOPHER:I am talking about the attitude, from the very beginning.
ETHAN:What do you want to say?
CHRISTOPHER:You are not only always comforting, but also comfortable.
RACHEL:Are you saying how he quickly got comfortable, and made us “calm down” at the beginning?
MEGAN:He got comfortable way too quickly.
ETHAN:I…, I’m just like this!(pause) I wasn’t comfortable, too. There is just no means to do the unnecessary! And this is just unnecessary.
CHRISTOPHER:You were the one who said to always choose the option with minimal damage. And so the answer is obvious.
(Christopher slams the button)(Rachel and Megan shocked)
AI VOICE:Please make your selection.One by one, state the name of the person you believe to be the robot. 1 minute remaining.
(Megan and Rachel look at each other)(Ethan petrified)
AI VOICE:Please make your final selection.
AI VOICE:HUMAN VERIFICATION TEST NUMBER #67 complete. Please proceed to the exit. The next test will begin in 5 minutes.

AI VOICE:There is no robot in the room.This test does not measure artificial intelligence.It measures how quickly human beings choose to sacrifice one another under pressure.Test completed. You may leave.

editorialChanges.change: Remove separate silence cue after 'You may leave.'; advance immediately to blackout.
Rename Boss (character name and dialogue references) to CEO throughout the manuscript.
